action.action-desc: Mr. McDowell (for himself, Mr. Van Orden, Mr. Ciscomani, Mr. Baird, and Mr. Van Epps) submitted the following resolution; which was referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs, and in addition to the Committees on Armed Services, and Foreign Affairs, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: Commemorating the fifth anniversary of the evacuation of Afghanistan, the Gulf war era, and honoring Gulf war era veterans.

whereas.text: Whereas, on August 2, 1990, the United States launched Operation Desert Shield to deter Iraqi aggression towards Saudi Arabia and prepare for the liberation of Kuwait;
Whereas, on January 16, 1991, the United States Armed Forces began Operation Desert Storm to liberate Kuwait from Iraqi occupation;
Whereas Kuwait was freed after an impressive 43-day air, land, and sea campaign that demonstrated the unrivaled skill and professionalism of the United States Armed Forces;
Whereas, in response to the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001, the United States launched Operation Enduring Freedom to dismantle al-Qaeda;
Whereas, on March 20, 2003, the United States launched Operation Iraqi Freedom to overthrow the Ba’athist government of Saddam Hussein;
Whereas, on May 2, 2011, the Navy’s SEAL Team 6 successfully eliminated Osama bin Laden in a raid on his compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan;
Whereas, on June 15, 2014, the United States responded to the rapid rise of the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria by launching Operation Inherent Resolve;
Whereas the United States Armed Forces completed their withdrawal from Afghanistan on August 30, 2021;

Whereas the United States honors those who sacrificed their lives facilitating the Afghanistan withdrawal, including the 13 members of the Armed Forces who were murdered in a terrorist attack on August 26, 2021;

Whereas, as of September 2023, approximately 8,400,000 veterans, about 43 percent of all living veterans, served during the Gulf war era, making them the largest single group of living veterans today;
Whereas August 28, 2026, marks the 5th anniversary of the evacuation of Afghanistan; and
Whereas tens of thousands of members of the Armed Forces remain in the Middle East protecting the United States and its allies from the Islamic Republic of Iran: Now, therefore, be it

paragraph.text: recognizes the millions of Gulf war veterans and their dedication to protecting the Nation;
honors the noble sacrifice of the Armed Forces and our allies who served in the Gulf wars;
recognizes the 5th anniversary of the evacuation of Afghanistan; and
reaffirms the commitment of Congress to honoring Gulf war veterans.
